description: 文学、历史与思想史研究，强调语料与版本、一手文本定位、文本与阐释分离、引文可核。
review_checklist: Research question and scope are explicit before close reading.
Corpus and edition selection rules are stated; excluded works are named.
Every quotation records work_id, locator, translation status, and verification state.
Text, translation, paraphrase, and interpretation are kept distinct.
Scholarly consensus and contested readings are both represented.
Authorial intention is not asserted as textual fact.
Page/line locators follow a declared scheme and match the cited edition.
Every claim maps to source IDs; no quote is cited without verification.
Limitations and unresolved interpretive disputes remain visible.
review_checklist_zh: 细读前已明确研究问题与范围。
语料与版本选择规则已说明，排除的作品已列明。
每条引文均记录作品编号、定位、译本状态与核验状态。
文本、译文、转述与阐释保持区分。
学界共识与争议性读法均有呈现。
不得将作者意图表述为文本事实。
页码/行号定位遵循既定方案，并与所引版本一致。
每条主张映射到来源编号；未经核验的引文不得引用。
局限与未决的阐释争议保持可见。
